title: Am I recovered enough for a hard day?

turns.question: Am I recovered enough for a hard day?
turns.answer: Yes, with one note. Your resting heart rate is close to your usual value, and your HRV is steady. Sleep was a little short last night, so keep the first part of the day easy.

# Your week in short

- HRV: inside your normal range

## What to do next

1. Keep your bedtime the same.
2. Add one easy walk on a low day.
3. Check the `body battery` in the morning.
